title: Shopify env-gated mandate path report (digital-product pilot)
description: Env-gated Shopify mandate path. Unset or blank SHOPIFY_STORE_URL is a no-op: the path does not inspect the bundle. A set value is validated as https with no userinfo and is never fetched. When armed, the path evaluates offline leakage predicates only. It does not invent a store URL, does not complete checkout, and is not a Done predicate. Operator env only — never a signed-mandate field.

kind.description: Path report domain. An observation receipt or shopping mandate is not this document.

live_store.description: This increment never contacts a live store.

fetched.description: The path never fetches. A configured URL is not a retrieval.

invented.description: No default store URL is synthesized. Only SHOPIFY_STORE_URL is read.

armed.description: true only when a valid https store URL is configured. Armed is still not live.

ready.description: true only when armed and every offline path predicate holds. Ready is not checkout approval.

path.description: idle when the env is unset or invalid. env_ready when a valid store URL is configured.

ok.description: false only when the env is set and the value is not a usable https URL.

enabled.description: true only when a valid https store URL is configured. Never implies a live call.

failed.description: Empty when idle (bundle not inspected) or when every armed predicate holds.

checkout_approved.description: The path cannot approve checkout. Human merchant-checkout stays on the offers rail.
